summary: Practice session: 2637 rule versions tested on 11 coins, 2 of 12 setups in the playbook (Breakdown short, VWAP loss short).

setups.label: Trend pullback
setups.plain: Buy when the 1h trend is up, price dips back to the 20-bar average within the last 3 bars, RSI is at most 51 and the candle closes back above the average during US hours (00-08 SGT). Stop 2.8 ATR away, target 2.75R, stop to breakeven at +1R, exit after 5h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Rally fade in a downtrend
setups.plain: Sell short when the 1h trend is down, price dips back to the 20-bar average within the last 5 bars, RSI is at least 49 and the candle closes back below the average during Europe hours (16-24 SGT). Stop 2.7 ATR away, target 3.25R, exit after 11h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Breakout
setups.plain: Buy when price closes above the 96-bar (24h) high on 2.3x normal volume, only when BTC is trending up during US hours (00-08 SGT). Stop 2.9 ATR away, target 3.25R, exit after 10h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Breakdown
setups.plain: Sell short when price closes below the 72-bar (18h) low on 2.3x normal volume, only with the 1h trend down, only when BTC is trending down during Europe hours (16-24 SGT). Stop 2.5 ATR away, target 3.5R, stop to breakeven at +1R, exit after 12h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Opening-range breakout
setups.plain: Buy when price breaks above the first hour's high (opening range, 08:00 SGT) within 7h of the open on 2.6x normal volume, only when BTC is trending up. Stop 2.5 ATR away, target 3R, exit after 7h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Opening-range breakdown
setups.plain: Sell short when price breaks below the first hour's low (opening range, 08:00 SGT) within 2h of the open on 2.5x normal volume. Stop 1.5 ATR away, target 4R, exit after 8h if neither is hit.

setups.label: VWAP reclaim
setups.plain: Buy when price was below VWAP in the last 2 bars and closes back above it on 2.5x normal volume, only with the 1h trend up, only when BTC is trending up during Asia hours (08-16 SGT). Stop 2 ATR away, target 4R, exit after 8h if neither is hit.

setups.label: VWAP loss
setups.plain: Sell short when price was above VWAP in the last 3 bars and closes back below it on 2.4x normal volume during US hours (00-08 SGT). Stop 3 ATR away, target 3.5R, stop to breakeven at +1R, exit after 10h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Stop-hunt reversal at the lows
setups.plain: Buy when price pokes under the 96-bar low (stop hunt) and closes back inside, RSI at most 25 during US hours (00-08 SGT). Stop 1.7 ATR away, target 4R, stop to breakeven at +1R, exit after 12h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Stop-hunt reversal at the highs
setups.plain: Sell short when price pokes over the 80-bar high (stop hunt) and closes back inside, RSI at least 73 during Europe hours (16-24 SGT). Stop 1.9 ATR away, target 4R, exit after 12h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Momentum burst
setups.plain: Buy when price has moved 3.25 ATR up in 2 bars on 1.9x volume during Europe hours (16-24 SGT). Stop 1.7 ATR away, target 3.5R, stop to breakeven at +1R, exit after 1h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Downside momentum burst
setups.plain: Sell short when price has moved 3 ATR down in 2 bars on 2.5x volume, only with the 1h trend down during Europe hours (16-24 SGT). Stop 1.5 ATR away, target 3R, exit after 2h if neither is hit.
